classes.name: StringAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a string autocomplete input with validation and dynamic options.

methods.description: Initializes form control with validators and sets up options filtering.

methods.description: Writes a new value to the component and updates the options accordingly.

methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change when input value changes.
